name: InterContinental Real Santo Domingo
insider_take: This luxurious retreat sits in the heart of the Americas' oldest European city, where 500-year-old colonial charm meets modern sophistication.
whats_special: The InterContinental Real Santo Domingo is uniquely positioned in the UNESCO World Heritage Zona Colonial, making it the only luxury international hotel within walking distance of Christopher Columbus's tomb and the first cathedral built in the New World. The hotel's rooftop pool offers stunning views of the Ozama River, where Columbus first anchored in 1492.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing east for breathtaking sunrise views over the Caribbean Sea and the ancient city walls – the same vista that greeted Spanish conquistadors over 500 years ago.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's complimentary historical walking tour to discover hidden gems like the 16th-century Alcázar de Colón palace, just 3 blocks away, and enjoy sunset cocktails at the hotel's terrace bar overlooking the cobblestone streets where merengue music drifts from local cafés.
pros: Prime location in historic Colonial Zone with UNESCO World Heritage sites nearby
Luxury accommodations with panoramic Caribbean Sea and Ozama River views
Full-service spa and multiple dining venues including rooftop restaurant
IHG Destined Program benefits with exclusive perks and upgrades
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting high-end positioning
Urban setting may have limited beach access compared to resort properties
